task_description: After the AI analyzes the problematic situation in phase 1 (PROBLEM_IDENTIFICATION), present a clear list of the specific information/data the user should collect for the next phase, so they know exactly what to gather. Backend enhances the analyze_problem prompt and exposes a collection_suggestions field; frontend renders it as a readable markdown list via the existing AIResponse component. Design = Option A (guidance shown right after phase-1 analysis, before advancing, non-blocking).

verification.summary: Backend: 94 pytest tests pass (baseline 92 + 2 new). Frontend: 41 vitest tests pass (baseline 39 + 2 new) and `npm run build` (tsc + vite) succeeds. New backend tests assert collection_suggestions equals the AI output on success and is '' on degraded (unconfigured/error) paths; new frontend tests assert the list+heading render for problem_identification and are hidden on ai_error. Tests exercise the new code paths and would fail if reverted. Docker build skipped (no live services needed; verification is fully via unit tests).
